resources.string: Select a saved SSH profile and explicitly check the key presented by its server. The check ends before authentication. No credentials, terminal or remote command are used.
Saved profiles or trust storage are unavailable. Refresh explicitly.
No saved SSH profiles. Add a profile in Connection profiles first.
Ready for an explicit key check.
Checking the server key without authentication…
The current check or presentation was cancelled. A previously admitted trust save may still complete.
Compare the exact host, port and SHA256 fingerprint through an independent trusted channel. A changed key may indicate interception; do not accept it solely because the connection reached a server.
This saves only the displayed key for this app and peer. It does not authenticate or resume this connection. Any further check requires a fresh explicit action.
The exact observed key was saved. Authentication was not attempted. Use a fresh Check host key action to observe the server again.
Key matches saved trust; authentication not attempted.
A trust-save outcome has not been confirmed. Refresh saved state explicitly before another check or save. Refresh does not identify which attempt caused the current state.
Current saved profiles and trust were read successfully. Select a profile for a fresh check.
The key presentation expired. Start a fresh check before deciding.
The operation could not finish (%1$s). No authentication was attempted. Refresh or start a fresh check explicitly; trust saves are not retried automatically.
Android local-network permission may be needed for this target. After the permission prompt, start a fresh check explicitly.
The permission prompt ended. Select a profile and start a fresh check explicitly; no check was resumed.
Saved presentation metadata was invalid. No check or approval was restored. Refresh saved state explicitly.
